comparability_and_caveats.comparison_key: market decision/as_of date exactly as produced
comparability_and_caveats.consumer_complete_gate: Every market must be non-UNKNOWN and CURRENT or CURRENT_AS_FETCHED_NOT_PIT as allowed by its source-frequency rule; pending, failed, stale, calendar-unknown, source-not-advanced, or required unassessed state prevents COMPLETE.

evaluation_clock: Explicit caller-supplied evaluation_at, retained and hash-bound. Never infer from source generated_at or local wall clock.

event_receipt.external_evidence_trust: This offline helper validates content/identity and temporal coherence. Original GitHub payload acquisition, exact source publication binding and official calendar provenance are supplied by separately reviewed existing adapters. A self-supplied hash/verified boolean alone is not provider authenticity.
event_receipt.hash_binding: Hash exact retained event/readback bytes and source-output bytes against independently supplied expected identities; include consumed hashes and explicit evaluation_at in eligibility identity.
event_receipt.missing_semantics: Missing evidence required for a particular eligibility conclusion yields UNCONFIRMED for that claim. No timestamp/slot/hash/step/causal-output invention.
event_receipt.terminal_failure: An actual matching failed/cancelled completed run proves COLLECTION_FAILED even if failed run produced no output; missing output is never fabricated.
event_receipt.terminal_observed_at: Record when actual completed-event/readback bytes were observed. This is not exact run completion time.
event_receipt.terminal_success: Success alone is insufficient for CURRENT. Require matching source publication identity and due slot evidence appropriate to that source; absent causal binding remains DUE_COLLECTION_UNCONFIRMED.

no_classification: Reuse already-produced PAPER classifications unchanged. This helper must not normalize Crypto axes, aggregate scores, advance strategy state, size positions or issue orders.

CRYPTO_BTC_AND_BREADTH.frequency: daily, prior finalized UTC price day

CRYPTO_STABLECOIN.frequency: daily first-complete snapshot across configured capture slots
CRYPTO_STABLECOIN.observation_date_rule: same-day successful event or independently confirmed skipped-existing event; crypto never uses holiday carry

KR_FIVE_SIGNALS.observation_date_rule: as_of_date must equal latest officially completed OPEN_REGULAR session only after successful publication event

US_ETF_DAILY.observation_date_rule: must equal latest officially completed US session when current eligible

US_TOTBKCR.eligibility: CURRENT_AS_FETCHED_NOT_PIT after successful current fetch; unchanged weekly value is permitted
US_TOTBKCR.observation_date_rule: retain observation_date and previous_observation_date from FRED response
US_TOTBKCR.raw_replay_limit: current response is hash-attested; do not claim full historical PIT from this field alone

US_VIXCLS.eligibility: CURRENT_AS_FETCHED_NOT_PIT only after a successful current collection event and retained raw hash validation
US_VIXCLS.observation_date_rule: retain FRED observation_date; must not be forced to ETF session date

US_WRESBAL.eligibility: CURRENT_AS_FETCHED_NOT_PIT after successful current fetch; unchanged weekly value is permitted
US_WRESBAL.observation_date_rule: retain observation_date and previous_observation_date from FRED response
US_WRESBAL.raw_replay_limit: current response is hash-attested; do not claim full historical PIT from this field alone

unchanged_and_hysteresis.daily_expected_session_exception: If a new completed daily session is expected but the successful event leaves the old observation date, the market is SOURCE_NOT_ADVANCED_EXPECTED_SESSION, not CURRENT.
unchanged_and_hysteresis.event_identity: A new independently evidenced successful collection event can confirm a source was fetched even when output bytes are unchanged.
unchanged_and_hysteresis.observation_identity: Hysteresis advances only when observation_identity_sha256 changes for a newly finalized market observation.
unchanged_and_hysteresis.slower_frequency_exception: A successful current fetch may retain the latest weekly FRED observation as CURRENT_AS_FETCHED_NOT_PIT without pretending it is a new daily observation.
unchanged_and_hysteresis.unchanged_source_hash: Never advances hysteresis and never rewrites the retained source artifact.
